title: Risks of Using AI Models Developed by Competing Nations
summary: The proliferation of open and offline AI models presents significant risks, particularly when these models are developed by rival nations or communities. Organizations must prioritize rigorous vetting of model lineage, conduct thorough security audits, and stay informed about emerging threats to mitigate these dangers while leveraging the benefits of offline AI for privacy and IP protection.
